name: retry-reuses-the-same-instruction
why: What fillsOwnGaps rests on. A retry fills the blank cells of the column the first run made only when the source column, the target name AND the instruction all match the lineage entry character for character; anything else appends a second column, which is the bug the gap-fill was written to remove. The instruction is free text the model writes, so nothing guarantees it comes back identical — except that the first call is still in the history to copy from. This case measures whether it does. Measured 2026-09-20 on glm-5.3-flash: 4/4, byte-identical each time, with rows 11–15 named. A red here does not break anything — the run appends, as it did before — but it means the gap-fill quietly never fires.
handWritten: Not minted. mint-cases.mjs replays dispatchTool, which refuses transform_column because its result is built inside runTransform in the React layer. The TOOL_RESULT below is assembled by hand out of the same sentences that code emits. Pull the result building out of CellsApp into a pure function and this case can be minted like the rest.
